Pepperl+Fuchs’ explosion-protected mobile devices designed for frontline use are now available through Everphone’s device-as-a-service model. Pepperl+Fuchs and Everphone have entered into a strategic partnership in which explosion-protected mobile devices will be available through Everphone’s device-as-a-service (DaaS) model. Everphone's DaaS model allows industrial and energy companies to centralize management of all their tablets and smartphones, including those used in hazardous environments. The following devices from the Pepperl+Fuchs mobile product line are now available through Everphone:. Everphone’s DaaS offering includes a range of accessories for industrial use from USB-C connectors for connecting external displays to the Bluetooth-enabled RSM-Ex 01 BT Z0 remote speaker microphone for safe use in high-noise environments. The partnership aims to simplify mobile work in industrial environments from plant maintenance and quality assurance to real-time data collection, according to the companies.

results.title: Uber brings robotic delivery to new South Florida metro area - Chain Store Age
results.content: Uber Technologies is expanding the geographic reach of a delivery partnership with a provider of autonomous sidewalk delivery robots. The Uber Eats on-demand delivery subsidiary of Uber is building on a long-time collaboration with Serve Robotics by making deliveries using Serve’s artificial intelligence-equipped sidewalk robots in Fort Lauderdale, Fla. Fort Lauderdale customers in the downtown and Las Olas Boulevard neighborhoods may now have their restaurant orders delivered by Serve’s robots. The expansion of this partnership marks another step forward in the expansion of sidewalk robots on Uber Eats, which has been offering Serve's autonomous deliveries in Los Angeles since 2022. It has an agreement to deploy up to 2,000 delivery robots on the Uber Eats platform across multiple U.S. markets.). The Fort Lauderdale launch supports Serve’s broader expansion strategy as it moves toward deploying 2,000 delivery robots across the U.S. by year end in partnership with Uber Eats. * ### Uber expands robotic delivery with new global partnership. Uber Technologies is rolling out autonomous sidewalk robot delivery across multiple markets.
